source: Week 2 of the Nov 8 cycle, rebuilt Sunday 1pm from the Nov 15 inventory walkthrough. Nothing from week 1 got cooked, so the thawed fridge proteins go first and three week-1 recipes come back. Four new dinners: kofta, spicy sausage ragù (Austin's hot marinara), satay beef and smoked NY strip.

targets.austin: ~1800 (1750–1900), 150g+. Workout days Mon + Wed (soccer): +300–400 cal at dinner.

ingredient_overlap: Cucumbers ×3 → tzatziki, Greek salad, lunch jars, tuna base, Mon salmon. Kale → lunch jars, Gruyère chicken, ragù, Sat slaw. Feta → kofta, salad, lunches, tuna. Coconut milk → coconut rice + satay glaze. Quinoa → Sun dinner + 3 lunches. Scallions → kofta, salmon, satay, potatoes. Green apples → Sat slaw + Thu–Sat tuna base.
flexible_order: Tue chicken and Wed ragù can't slide later (thawed chicken; ragù is fine to Thu). Fri and Sat can swap if you start the smoker Friday.
assumptions: Thawed salmon covers 8 oz Austin + 5 oz Cameron; if it's only 2 × 5 oz, Austin adds 2 eggs.

prep.cycle_note: Cycle Nov 8 → 21, week 2 of 2 (refresh week). Week 1's dinners were never cooked, so this week cooks the thawed fridge proteins first (salmon, lamb, chicken, flat iron, sausage) and brings back three week-1 recipes (miso salmon, Gruyère chicken, tuna kits). Plan landed Sunday at 1pm, so the Friday-night thaw is already done (everything was thawed). Sunday prep ~1h50 hands-on. Freezer bank going into the Nov 22 cycle: ~3 portions spicy ragù, kofta extras, ribeye, 4 sausage links, ~3 lb wings, tilapia, 2 chicken thighs, 1 flat iron.
